lines.zh: 我顺着走廊走，脸一直朝后。
lines.en: I walk the corridor with my face turned backward.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你的合上了。
lines.en: My footsteps sync with yours.

lines.zh: 我走得很自然，像个熟人。
lines.en: I walk naturally, like someone you know.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边长出新的指头。
lines.en: As I walk, new fingers sprout.

lines.zh: 我在你刚才站的地方停了一下。
lines.en: I pause where you were standing.

lines.zh: 我绕过水渍，不想被看出来。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle so nothing shows.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀在走路时错开了一寸。
lines.en: My shoulder slips a fraction out of place as I walk.
I walk the edge of the camp.
I count the tents, one by one.

lines.zh: 我把头抬得很正，学人走路。
lines.en: I hold my head straight and imitate a person.

lines.zh: 我走过灯下，脸裂了一下。
lines.en: I pass under the lamp and my face splits.
I walk slowly; there's no hurry.
I brush past the edge of the crowd.

lines.zh: 我跟着一个背影走了很久。
lines.en: I follow a back for a long way.
Two sets of my footprints on the ground.
When I leave, no one turns around.

lines.zh: 我站着，学着像人一样呼吸。
lines.en: I stand and practice breathing like a person.

lines.zh: 我的脸分成两半，又合上。
lines.en: My face splits in two, then closes.
I'm counting how many are in this room.
I imitate the poster on the wall.
A sound; I stop to listen.

lines.zh: 我把手放在胸口，什么也没有。
lines.en: I put a hand to my chest; there's nothing there.

lines.zh: 我在想，谁最适合被替换。
lines.en: I wonder who would be best replaced.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地张开嘴，又闭上。
lines.en: I open my mouth slowly, then close it.
Snow lands on my shoulder and doesn't melt.

lines.zh: 我像石头一样蹲在雪里。
lines.en: I crouch in the snow like a stone.
I'm watching how you people talk.

lines.zh: 我的手指在数自己的关节。
lines.en: My fingers count their own joints.

lines.zh: 我想起一个不属于我的名字。
lines.en: A name that isn't mine comes to mind.
I tilt my head, waiting to be called.
I don't move at all, like a block of wood.

lines.zh: 裂开的脸，各自听见一点。
lines.en: Each half of my face hears a little.

lines.zh: 你看我，是不是觉得眼熟。
lines.en: Look at me. Don't I seem familiar?
This face is one I borrowed.
What's your name? Let me note it.

lines.zh: 你身后那位，也认识我吗。
lines.en: Does the one behind you know me too?

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，裂缝在嘴边。
lines.en: When I smile, the seam shows at my mouth.
Don't stare too long; I'll learn you.
Your face is neater than mine.

lines.zh: 我在想，你的声音是什么样。
lines.en: I wonder what your voice is like.
Put that knife down first.

lines.zh: 我们见过吗？也许是明天。
lines.en: Have we met? Perhaps tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我抬手打招呼，姿势很怪。
lines.en: I wave hello, and the motion is wrong.

lines.zh: 你多看一会儿，就看不出破绽了。
lines.en: Look longer and the flaw disappears.
My face has split wider.
It hurts; a piece came off.

lines.zh: 我学着像人一样叫了一声。
lines.en: I cry out the way a person would.
I retreat and lean on the wall.
My skin is stitching itself back.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的形状打乱了。
lines.en: That scrambled my shape.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，手指少了一根。
lines.en: I raise a hand; a finger is gone.
I breathe in, and my lungs feel wrong.
My face splits open down the middle.
I need somewhere else to grow back.
You're all gathered together. How convenient.
That coat. I want it.

lines.zh: 说话声一多，我就靠过去。
lines.en: The more voices, the closer I drift.
Your scent is very like mine.
I reach a hand into the firelight.

lines.zh: 有人愿意让我搭个肩吗。
lines.en: Would someone let me lean on them?
That hat would suit my head.
What are you laughing at? I'd like to laugh too.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近火堆，不着急。
lines.en: I edge toward the fire, unhurried.
Warm voices; I want to stay near.
That door isn't shut. I noticed.
Someone dropped a glove.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我一直在学。
lines.en: While you talk, I keep learning.

lines.zh: 我站在你们中间，谁也不看。
lines.en: I stand among you and look at no one.
That one is alone; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 靠得再近一点，我就够了。
lines.en: A little closer, and I'll have enough.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，摸到的是软的。
lines.en: You bump into me, and what you touch is soft.
My face rubs against your shoulder.
Don't touch the back of my neck.
I steady you with the same motion.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，像认识很久。
lines.en: We crowd together like old friends.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的手，我不在意。
lines.en: You step on my hand; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，让得太快了。
lines.en: I give way too quickly.
That knock cost me a small piece.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀贴过去，试探一下。
lines.en: I lean my shoulder in to test you.
We're close, and I smell blood.
Another like me walks in.
We share a single face.
It hands me a small piece of itself.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，合成一团。
lines.en: We fuse into one heap.
We speak in the same person's voice.
Two shadows, one outline.
It has become more complete than I.

lines.zh: 我们一起抬头，看着路过的人。
lines.en: We lift our heads together to watch someone pass.
Which is which is no longer clear.

lines.zh: 我们会长成更大的东西。
lines.en: We will grow into something larger.

lines.zh: 我捡起那只手套，套在手上。
lines.en: I pick up the glove and put it on.
This coat fits me well.

lines.zh: 我把帽子按在头上，歪了。
lines.en: I press the hat on; it sits crooked.
A knife. I'll keep it.
What lies on the ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我拾起一张布告，看不懂。
lines.en: I pick up a notice I can't read.
I slip the bone into my pocket.
This button will mend a coat.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，把东西卷进袖子里。
lines.en: I bend and roll it into my sleeve.
I'll hold it and pretend it's yours.

lines.zh: 雪地上只有你一串脚印。
lines.en: Only one line of footprints marks the snow.

lines.zh: 我在你身后站了一会儿了。
lines.en: I've been behind you for a while.

lines.zh: 我的脸裂开了，两半都看你。
lines.en: My face split in two. Both halves watch you.
It's gone quiet here.
I've decided on you.
Don't be afraid; it doesn't hurt.
My face splits toward you.
You shouldn't have turned around.
We're so alike; who could tell.
I reach and catch your collar.
I copy the way you walk.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，影子都少一个。
lines.en: Wherever you go, one shadow is missing.
I lay a hand against your back.
You turn, and I take another direction.

lines.zh: 我一直在你旁边，你不觉得吗。
lines.en: I've been beside you all along. Didn't you notice?
One person is missing from this room.
I'm very close, and you can't see me.
I'm waiting for you to walk in.

lines.zh: 声音是从你旁边传来的。
lines.en: The sound comes from beside you.
One more step is all I need.
I seize the back of your neck.
The seam opens and bites.
I press my whole body to yours.
Claws push out of my palm.
You hit the wall with no room left.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，别人听不见。
lines.en: A soft blow; no one will hear.

lines.zh: 你喊的时候，声音不像自己。
lines.en: Your shout doesn't sound like you.
I drag you into the dark.

lines.zh: 我的手指绕住你的手腕。
lines.en: My fingers wrap your wrist.
You go limp. Good.
There's one more person in the group.

lines.zh: 我从谁的衣服里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of someone's clothes.

lines.zh: 门口站着一个人，不太对。
lines.en: Someone stands in the doorway, not quite right.
A hand pushes out from under the snow.

lines.zh: 有人在帐篷里数错了人数。
lines.en: Someone miscounts in the tent.

lines.zh: 我接过一件外套，穿上了。
lines.en: I'm handed a coat and put it on.
I wasn't in this camp before.

lines.zh: 我从刚才那个人身上分出来。
lines.en: I split off from the one who was just here.
No one noticed the count changed.

lines.zh: 我学第一句话，学得很像。
lines.en: My first sentence comes out just right.
Fire makes my face draw inward.
I fall and spread out flat.

lines.zh: 水渗进来，我的形状散了。
lines.en: Water seeps in and my shape comes apart.
The blast peels my skin back.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我肩上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and won't come out.
That spell kills this part of me.

lines.zh: 太久没东西可换，我撑不住。
lines.en: Too long with nothing to replace; I'm failing.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个人抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body convulses.
The void peels me open layer by layer.
